findings.detail: The run checks only that the final summary path does not exist and is not itself a symlink, then calls write_json(output, report) before validating the output's parent chain. If an ancestor such as evidence/cases or the consequence case directory is a symlink, the initial report write follows it outside evidence. The later _regular checks and audit reject the escaped path only after this write has happened.
findings.requested_fix: Before the first write_json, validate the full destination-parent chain from the resolved evidence root, rejecting symlinked/aliased ancestors and requiring the consequence output root to be fresh. Keep the existing read-time _regular checks and audit.
